response.overview: After an Argument Bruno is bitten by an Infected, Henry carries the guilt of this on his  own shoulders, this leads to him taking care of an infected Bruno like its a pet, clinging  onto what is left of his friend, after failing to tame the beast Henry decides to honor  Bruno’s “dying wish”, euthanizes him and moves on. This leads Henry to discover a  lone dog who has lost its owners to nature, Henry takes the dog under its wing and  places the dog tag he inherited from Bruno around its neck, giving new meaning to  Bruno’s Legacy
response.title: BRUNO
